newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Giken Sakata announces management change.
newsitem.headline: Giken Sakata announces management change.

text.p: Giken Sakata (Singapore) Pte Ltd announced on Friday changes in its top management with immediate effect.
The company said in a statement, executive president Sakae Yokota had been appointed executive chairman while executive vice president Shigeo Nakagawa is now executive president.
Giken said Yasufumi Tsunoda had been appointed a director.
The manufacturer of electronic products earlier reported a net profit of S$0.03 million for year ended March 31, 1997 compared to a loss of S$4.55 million a year ago.
